cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a government data exchange platform is in service, counts the bodies connected or gives a figure for its use.
cells.note: On 17 November 2026 the PAFEN project issued an IDA-funded request for proposals for a government interoperability platform on the X-Road model (BDI-003), so a platform is being procured: stage 2. Nothing is in service, so not 3.
